Reference: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log line 'AI explain failed: ... Budget has been exceeded'.

action_items: URGENT: Investigate Emergent LLM key budget — Max budget of $0.001 is far too low; each Claude call costs ~$0.007. Either raise the budget on the key, switch to a higher-tier key, or expose this as a graceful UX state ('Generating analysis...' instead of silently falling back).
Confirm fallback messaging is acceptable until LLM budget is fixed. Today the user has no indication the explanation is canned.
Add testID='rollover-cta-button' to the 'VIEW FULL AI BREAKDOWN' Pressable in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/rollover.tsx for stable e2e selectors.
Audit source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (likely a Reanimated/Gesture-Handler dep) — track but no immediate fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_engine.py swallows ALL exceptions from chat.send_message and returns fallback silently — consider logging the full error AND surfacing a flag on the pick (e.g., explanation_source='fallback') so the frontend can warn the user or skip displaying the block.

server.py /api/picks/{id} persists the fallback text into Mongo on first call, so even after the LLM budget is restored, the cached fallback will keep being returned. Recommend not caching fallback explanations (only cache real LLM responses) OR allow a force-regenerate query param.

sports_engine.py uses random.uniform inside generate_all_picks final loop to recompute edge — this makes responses non-deterministic across refresh calls and undermines the lock_score → edge relationship. Consider seeding with date+external_id for reproducibility.
server.py: pick_date is computed via _today_str() (UTC) — for users in PST/EST this can flip 'today' at unintuitive moments. Consider exposing date filter to client.
sports_engine.py is ~600 lines; consider splitting per-sport fetchers into separate modules for maintainability (>700 threshold not yet crossed but close).

rca_of_issue: Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration is non-functional: backend logs show `litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.007395, Max budget: 0.001`. The configured EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (sk-emergent-a8b22C7Fd083243E59) has a $0.001 budget cap which is below a single Claude Sonnet 4.5 message cost (~$0.007). Each /api/picks/{id} call therefore: (1) attempts Claude call, (2) hits budget exception, (3) ai_engine catches and returns _fallback_explanation, (4) server.py caches the fallback in Mongo permanently. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://canonical-parity.preview.emergentagent.com/api/picks/<id>` and observe `.explanation` matches `_fallback_explanation` format. Mitigation: increase budget on Emergent LLM key OR rotate to a key with adequate budget, AND modify server.py to NOT cache fallback explanations so they regenerate once the key works.
